title: Dictionaries and sets
description:
Complete the methods:

```csharp
public static Dictionary<string, int> WordCounts(string text)             // lower-case words; letters and ' only
public static List<List<string>> GroupAnagrams(IEnumerable<string> words)
public static char? FirstRepeated(string text)                           // the first character seen a second time
public static Dictionary<string, List<string>> Invert(Dictionary<string, string> owners)
```

- `WordCounts` splits the text into words made of letters and apostrophes (anything else separates words), lower-cased.
- `GroupAnagrams(["tea", "eat", "tan", "ate", "nat", "bat"])` gives `[["tea", "eat", "ate"], ["tan", "nat"], ["bat"]]`: groups in the order their first word appears, words in their original order. Anagrams have the same letters in any order; compare ignoring case.
- `FirstRepeated("swiss")` is `'s'`; `FirstRepeated("abc")` is `null`.
- `Invert` turns item → owner into owner → items, with each owner's items sorted alphabetically (ordinal).
hints: Sorting a word's letters gives the same key for all its anagrams: `"tea"`, `"eat"` and `"ate"` all become `"aet"`.
`HashSet.Add` returns `false` when the value was already there, which is exactly the moment a character repeats.
